mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing a comfortable 77 degrees under mainly clear skies at Badger Prairie County Park, with the moon currently in a waxing gibbous phase.

The City of Verona is launching an eighteen month update to its Comprehensive Plan to guide future growth. They have formed a task force and invite all citizens to stay involved through the Envision Verona project website.

There is a lot of fun on the calendar including Hop Haus Trivia and Quizmasters Trivia at Lake Lou-ee happening today, followed by the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market and Wednesday Trivia at The Bogey Factory tomorrow.
Looking at the weekly report, on August 19, there was a motor vehicle crash on North Main Street where a 19 year old driver was cited for operating with a suspended license.
Today is the perfect day to stop by Culver's for the OREO Cookie Cheesecake flavor of the day, as they are open until 10 PM tonight.
